description: Generative-Agents-style reflection (agent-driven, no LLM in the server). mode:"gather" (default) returns the most reflection-worthy memories (high importance × recent) as material plus an instruction to synthesize 1–3 higher-level insights. mode:"store" persists a synthesized insight (provenance="reflection") and "derived_from"-links it to its source memories.

insight.description: store: the higher-level insight you synthesized from the gathered material

limit.description: gather: max reflection-material rows to return (default 10)

mode.description: "gather" (default): the server SELECTs the most reflection-worthy memories (high importance × recent) as material for you to synthesize. "store": persist a synthesized insight back, linked to its source memories.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

source_ids.description: store: ids of the source memories this insight was derived from (linked via "derived_from"; non-existent ids are skipped)

title.description: store: optional short title for the stored insight

name: memory_reflect
